summary: Second appeal under Section 100 CPC; concurrent factual findings revisited on substantial question of law; interpretation of documentary evidence; patta mutation and revenue history as title evidence; mortgage redemption and sale chain established; High Court erroneously interfered; standard: findings must be perverse or evidence ignored; title and possession to entire suit property upheld; impugned judgment set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Guran Ditta v. T. Ram Ditta
Yadarao Dajiba Shrawane v. Nanilal Harakchand Shah
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; concurrent findings of trial and first appellate courts restored; declaration of title and permanent injunction granted for entire suit property.
